title.en: Sugar work from field to boiling house
title.zh: 从蔗田到煮糖房的劳动

alt.en: Workers cut and carry cane beside a mill and a long boiling house.
alt.zh: 工人在磨坊和长形煮糖房旁砍伐、搬运甘蔗。

caption.en: A 1683 engraving after Leclerc’s design of about 1671 follows sugar production from cane fields to processing equipment.
caption.zh: 1683年版画依据勒克莱尔约1671年的设计，将蔗田与加工器具组织在同一画面。

interpretation.en: Cutting, carrying, milling and boiling appear in one ordered composition. Compare the visible skilled tasks with the coercive labour system described in the story.
interpretation.zh: 砍伐、搬运、碾压与煮糖被组织在一幅有序构图中。把可见的熟练工序与故事中的强制劳动制度对照阅读。

title.en: Dining at the Canal Commission hotel
title.zh: 运河委员会旅馆的餐厅

alt.en: Diners sit at rows of tables under the rafters of a large dining hall.
alt.zh: 就餐者坐在大餐厅屋架下的一排排餐桌旁。

caption.en: American and European canal workers dining at Culebra, about 1910, as identified by the collection.
caption.zh: 约1910年库莱布拉的运河工人用餐；馆藏辨识为美国及欧洲劳动者。

interpretation.en: Rows of tables turn meals into an organized service. Compare this large dining hall with the workers’ households at Cristóbal.
interpretation.zh: 成排餐桌显示有组织的用餐服务。把这间大餐厅与克里斯托瓦尔的工人住房对照起来。

title.zh: 克里斯托瓦尔的工人家庭住房

alt.en: Wooden dwellings line a raised walkway, with children and other residents outside.
alt.zh: 木制住房排列在架高的步道两侧，孩子与其他居民站在屋外。

caption.en: Housing for West Indian and Panamanian canal workers at Cristóbal, about 1910, with children in the walkway.
caption.zh: 约1910年克里斯托瓦尔的西印度与巴拿马运河工人住房，步道上可见儿童。

interpretation.en: Wooden dwellings open onto shared raised walkways. The children make household life visible within the history of a construction workforce.
interpretation.zh: 木制住房面向共用的架高步道。孩子的身影让家庭生活进入工程劳工的历史。

alt.en: Carved façades rise from reddish cliffs beside small figures and a rocky foreground.
alt.zh: 雕刻立面从红褐色峭壁中耸起，旁有小幅人物，前景为岩石地面。

caption.en: Haghe’s 1849 lithograph after Roberts presents Petra’s surviving rock-cut architecture.
caption.zh: 哈格依罗伯茨作品制作的1849年石版画，描绘佩特拉留存的岩凿建筑。

interpretation.en: The small figures accentuate the scale of carved façades and cliffs. Follow where masonry-like architectural forms emerge from the rock itself.
interpretation.zh: 小幅人物衬出雕凿立面与峭壁的尺度。观察仿佛砌筑的建筑形式，怎样直接从岩体中浮现。

title.zh: 伊散德尔瓦纳之后的英国教训

alt.en: A Zulu man writes “Despise not your enemy” on a blackboard before a seated British figure.
alt.zh: 一名祖鲁男子在黑板上写下“不要轻视你的敌人”，一名英国形象坐在前方。

caption.en: An 1879 British cartoon turns the defeat at Isandlwana into a lesson against underestimating an opponent.
caption.zh: 1879年英国讽刺画把伊散德尔瓦纳战败化为轻敌的教训。

interpretation.en: The chalkboard reverses the roles of teacher and pupil. British complacency is the target, while the figures retain the stereotypes of British imperial satire.
interpretation.zh: 黑板将教师与学生的角色颠倒：英国的自满受到讽刺，人物仍带有英国帝国讽刺画的刻板形象。

title.en: Tongan boats in a voyage engraving
title.zh: 航海版画中的汤加船只

alt.en: Large sailing vessels and smaller canoes occupy a choppy sea beneath dark clouds.
alt.zh: 大型帆船与较小的独木舟航行在乌云下起伏的海面上。

caption.en: Tongan sailing vessels in a 1777 engraving after observations made during Cook’s second voyage.
caption.zh: 1777年版画中的汤加帆船，依据库克第二次航行期间的观察绘制。

interpretation.en: Compare the tall sails, low hulls and smaller canoes. This European voyage image gives maritime mobility a visible form within the story of island connections.
interpretation.zh: 比较高帆、低矮船身与小型独木舟。这幅欧洲航海图像，让岛际联系中的海上流动获得具体形态。

title.en: Stone tools from the ancient Tongan state reveal prehistoric interaction centers in the Central Pacific
title.zh: 古代汤加国家的石器揭示太平洋中部史前交往中心

title.en: Kava and chiefly authority on Tongatapu
title.zh: 汤加塔布的卡瓦饮礼与首领权威

alt.en: A crowd sits in a large roofed hall around a central ceremonial gathering.
alt.zh: 人群坐在宽大的有顶大厅内，围绕中央的仪式聚会。

caption.en: A 1784 engraving of kava ceremony and deference to Tuʻi Tonga Paulaho; the collection tentatively connects it to June 1777.
caption.zh: 1784年版画表现卡瓦饮礼及对图伊汤加保拉霍的敬礼；馆方暂将场景系于1777年6月。

interpretation.en: Rows of seated figures direct attention toward the central ceremony. The composition makes social rank visible alongside the seafaring technology in the paired boat image.
interpretation.zh: 成排而坐的人群把视线引向中央仪式。构图使社会等级可见，与另一幅船图中的航海技术形成对读。

items.date: 1784; probably depicts a ceremony in June 1777

alt.en: A seated bronze Buddha fills the image above an offering table and incense vessels.
alt.zh: 端坐的铜佛占据画面主体，下方有供桌与香器。

caption.en: Beato’s photograph of Kamakura’s surviving Great Buddha, cataloged about 1868.
caption.zh: 比托拍摄镰仓留存的大佛，馆藏定年约1868年。

interpretation.en: Offerings, vessels and trees surround the monumental seated figure. The later photograph records a surviving Buddhist sculpture in Kamakura’s changing religious landscape.
interpretation.zh: 供物、器皿与树木围绕巨大的坐像。这幅较晚照片记录了镰仓宗教景观中留存的佛教雕塑。

title.zh: 曼谷的河流与寺院屋顶

alt.en: Temple roofs and a courtyard overlook a wide river and the buildings on its far bank.
alt.zh: 寺院屋顶和庭院俯临宽阔河流，远岸分布着建筑。

caption.en: Bangkok seen in Thomson’s 1865 negative, reproduced in this 1981 photographic print.
caption.zh: 汤姆森1865年底片记录的曼谷，此件照片于1981年印制。

interpretation.en: Layered temple roofs lead the eye toward the Chao Phraya River and its far bank. Religious buildings and river access share the same capital landscape.
interpretation.zh: 层叠寺院屋顶把视线引向湄南河与远岸。宗教建筑和河流通道共同构成都城景观。
